lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Uuugggghhh!

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: I feel like I've been sorting through supplies foreverrrrrrr!

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Why the heck did they send up so much?

lines.speaker: neon
lines.text: Still, it's kinda awesome having all this stuff around.

lines.speaker: neon
lines.text: Makes this place feel more like our turf, you know?

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Hmm...

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: That's true.
That's also the reason behind sending up our personal belongings.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Oh, that reminds me!

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Did you bring that thing, Rapi?

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: Bring what?

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: That cassette player Red Hood gave you.

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: I brought it.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Did you listen to some music on it?

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: Yeah, every time I have a spare moment.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Oh, really?

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Doesn't that make you feel like a granny? Kek!

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: It's certainly not what I'd usually be listening to.

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: It's such an antique that finding power is a hassle.

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: Still, I'm trying to get used to it.
What type of music do you prefer?

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: Me?

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: Actually...

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: Now that I think about it, I don't exactly have a favorite genre.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: First of all, it's pretty clear that the country vibe just doesn't suit you.

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: Might as well give it a try

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: since Red Hood left this for me.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: I wanna listen to it too.

lines.speaker: neon
lines.text: Yeah, play it for us the next time!

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: Okay.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: By the way, Commander,

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: did you send Red Hood's recording to the Pilgrims?
I've been trying, but the connection is so bad.

lines.speaker: neon
lines.text: They've probably wandered off into the boonies again.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Wonder if they'll be cool with us sending them this?

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: I mean, we could just be reopening old wounds.

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: I think they'll like it.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Really?

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: I sure hope so.
